sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Dawley Town on Saturday at 14:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent league loss. Sandbach remain firmly at the top with 31 points from 14 games, having won four of their last five league matches before that defeat, and will be keen to reassert their authority against a Dawley side currently mid-table.
divisionWide: The rest of the division plays out a full Saturday fixture card at 15:00, with several key battles shaping the title race and relegation picture. Second-placed AFC Bridgnorth's nearest challengers include Bilston Town (3rd, 26pts) and Stafford Town (4th, 26pts), who host Telford Town in their own fixture; Stafford have shown mixed recent form with draws dominating their last six, while Telford sit bottom with just one win all season. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently 5th with 25 points, face Allscott Heath (8th), a clash between sides both in positive form. Eccleshall (7th) host Shawbury United (15th) in a fixture between contrasting mid-table positions, while Foley Meir (12th) welcome Barnton (6th), who have been consistent with recent wins. Cheadle Heath Nomads (10th) travel to Brereton Social (14th) in a lower-mid-table encounter. Market Drayton Town (16th) visit Crewe (17th) in a battle of struggling sides, while New Mills (9th) host Wednesfield Community (13th). Widnes Town (20th) travel to Alsager Town (19th) in a basement clash, with both teams desperately seeking wins; Alsager have lost five of their last six league games while Widnes are on a run of poor results.
